optimized_sql:
SELECT MIN(n.name) AS voicing_actress,
       MIN(t.title) AS kung_fu_panda
FROM (
    SELECT movie_id, company_id
    FROM movie_companies
    WHERE note LIKE '%(200%)%'
      AND (note LIKE '%(USA)%' OR note LIKE '%(worldwide)%')
) AS mc
JOIN (
    SELECT id
    FROM company_name
    WHERE country_code = '[us]'
) AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
JOIN (
    SELECT id, title
    FROM title
    WHERE production_year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2008
      AND title LIKE '%Kung%Fu%Panda%'
) AS t ON t.id = mc.movie_id
JOIN (
    SELECT movie_id, info_type_id
    FROM movie_info
    WHERE info IS NOT NULL
      AND (info LIKE 'Japan:%2007%' OR info LIKE 'USA:%2008%')
) AS mi ON mi.movie_id = mc.movie_id
        AND mi.movie_id = t.id
JOIN (
    SELECT id, movie_id, person_id, role_id, person_role_id
    FROM cast_info
    WHERE note = '(voice)'
) AS ci ON ci.movie_id = mc.movie_id
        AND ci.movie_id = t.id
        AND ci.movie_id = mi.movie_id
JOIN (
    SELECT id
    FROM info_type
    WHERE info = 'release dates'
) AS it ON it.id = mi.info_type_id
JOIN (
    SELECT id
    FROM role_type
    WHERE role = 'actress'
) AS rt ON rt.id = ci.role_id
JOIN (
    SELECT id, name
    FROM name
    WHERE gender = 'f'
      AND name LIKE '%Angel%'
) AS n ON n.id = ci.person_id
JOIN aka_name AS an ON an.person_id = n.id
        AND an.person_id = ci.person_id
JOIN char_name AS chn ON chn.id = ci.person_role_id
